verdict: Organic visibility is growing; paid channels remain off and need restarting.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity came from organic sources — paid advertising on Meta and Google ran zero spend, so no paid leads were generated this period. Your Google Business Profile produced 43 actions including 2 calls, 33 direction requests, and 8 website clicks, and Search Console clicks rose 33% week over week to 45 clicks from 4,412 impressions — a real sign that organic search visibility is building. However, 181 website sessions in the last 28 days resulted in zero tracked conversions, meaning the site is receiving visitors but not turning them into leads. Restarting paid campaigns is the immediate priority to put a lead-generation engine back in motion alongside the organic growth already underway.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks
week-over-week rise in organic search clicks, the strongest positive signal this period
paid leads generated this period — Meta and Google Ads were inactive all 28 days

watch_item.issue: 181 site visits this period produced zero tracked conversions, so organic traffic is arriving but not turning into leads.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaigns are being prepared for relaunch to drive higher-intent traffic while the conversion path is reviewed.
